title: Doozy Vape Co Fizzy Lemon Nicotine Salts
description: Fizzy Lemon nicotine salt e-liquid by Doozy Salts provides a blend of sparkling zest for a cool, fresh-tasting flavour. The subtle notes of sweet candy compliment the lemon for a punchy sherbet kick. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
